thread:
maya: FYI Snyk flagged CVE-2026-0789 in glibc (resolver) in redwood/base:2026-02. severity 9.0. tagging eng-runtime + infra. we should coordinate a minimal rebuild and signer RBAC tighten.
trent: can you share exploit preconditions?
maya: PoC needs writable mount + lax seccomp + resolver query payload. reproduced in local container.
rio: short mitigations: 1) enforce stricter seccomp on non-priv pods, 2) revoke CAP_SYS_ADMIN where unused, 3) block unauthenticated images via admission until signed.
trent: I'll push a staging seccomp patch to runner-group and run smoke tests. command I ran: `kubectl patch ds runner-canary -n infra --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/pod":"runtime/default"}}}}}'`
ci-bot: pipeline 221233 started for redwood/base:rebuild-5220001111 (job 221233)
maya: signing note: we must limit who can request cosign signing via KMS. current token-creator list: ci-signer-sa, infra-deploy-sa. propose remove infra-deploy-sa and bind short-lived token to keystore-agent only.
sec-oncall: approved change window tonight 23:00-00:00 UTC for RBAC change + key rotate. create ticket INFRA-4310 with rollback plan.
trent: admission webhook PR prepared to require cosign attestation; feature flag enabled for prod during rollout window. will add clear rollback toggle.
rio: I'll add SIEM rule to capture KMS.AsymmetricSign calls and cosign verify logs, forward to ops-audit. sample filter: `protoPayload.methodName:"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign"`

sec-oncall: after rollout run registry scan for images with glibc<=2.35 and notify owners.
maya: opening INFRA-4310 and will add follow-ups: trent -> webhook PR, rio -> SIEM sink, maya -> RBAC PR. closing thread.
